S.FORM: alang Gukut ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Syurin go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 174 buwan, 543 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 94% kyan ku 508 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 6% kyan ku 35 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Truku 83%, Amis 3%, Tayan 4%, Paywan 2%, binah lihuyan s'uli 3%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Gukut hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Gukut hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Gukut hya' ga bsilung. tay mkraya' na Gukut hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Gukut hya' ga Knlibu. tay mkyahu' na Gukut hya' ga Qnragan. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ɣukut ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu [s|ɕ]jurin ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa truku ** ami[s|ɕ] * tajan * pajwan * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na ɣukut ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na ɣukut ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na ɣukut ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj mkrajaʔ na ɣukut ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na ɣukut ħjaʔ ɣa knliβu taj mkjaħuʔ na ɣukut ħjaʔ ɣa qnraɣan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
